items.summary: Recommendation: reject new fleet design or implementation admission this cycle. Delivery is saturated at 10/10 slots, with deployed work awaiting measurement and open failed-work, security-evidence, finance-reconciliation, and parked-site readiness items. The highest-value reversible improvements are already queued or measuring; adding another change would create overlap and duplicate control-plane telemetry. Continue existing bounded work, validate deployed design outcomes with available telemetry, and admit the next visible site improvement only after a slot clears. No conversion lift is claimed.
